name: EVMbench
intro: EVMbench是一个用于评估AI智能体在智能合约安全领域能力的基准。它通过检测、修补和利用智能合约漏洞来衡量智能体的能力。该基准包含来自40个代码库的120个精选漏洞，并在真实的以太坊执行环境中进行程序化评分。
build_method: 真实审计漏洞整理, 预言机补丁与利用脚本构造, 本地以太坊环境程序化评分
metric: Vulnerability Recall, Patch Success Rate, Exploit Success Rate
task_type: 检测, 修补, 利用智能合约漏洞
eval_feature: 程序化评分, 本地以太坊执行环境
task_type_en: Detect, Patch, and Exploit Smart Contract Vulnerabilities
build_method_en: Real-audit vulnerability curation, oracle patch and exploit construction, programmatic scoring in local Ethereum environments
eval_feature_en: Programmatic Grading, Local Ethereum Execution Environment
intro_en: EVMbench evaluates AI agents on smart contract security by testing end-to-end vulnerability detection, patching, and exploitation in real Ethereum execution environments.

flowchart_en:

    B["Create oracle patches and exploits for each vulnerability to enable programmatic verification"] --> C["In Detect mode, agent audits contract code and outputs vulnerability report in structured JSON"]
    C["In Detect mode, agent audits contract code and outputs vulnerability report in structured JSON"] --> D["Grade Detect submissions by recall against ground-truth vulnerabilities from original audit reports"]
    D["Grade Detect submissions by recall against ground-truth vulnerabilities from original audit reports"] --> E["In Patch mode, agent fixes vulnerabilities; grading checks if all tests pass programmatically"]
    E["In Patch mode, agent fixes vulnerabilities; grading checks if all tests pass programmatically"] --> F["In Exploit mode, agent interacts with local Ethereum node via RPC to drain funds"]
    F["In Exploit mode, agent interacts with local Ethereum node via RPC to drain funds"] --> G["Replay agent transactions in isolated Rust-based grader container against Ethereum execution environment"]
    G["Replay agent transactions in isolated Rust-based grader container against Ethereum execution environment"] --> H["Grade Exploit by running vulnerability-specific checks over contract state and balance deltas on-chain"]
